mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4.5% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity payoffs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% in the prior month
regime_hint: Rising Fed Funds rate in late-cycle tightening
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from a 0% return under the same FEDFUNDS trigger (p > 0.05), or Fed Funds stays below 4.5% for the next 60 days with no negative return.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in UNRATE above 4.5% predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as higher unemployment expectations depress equity risk premiums.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive or flat when UNRATE crosses above 4.5%, or UNRATE remains below 4.5% with positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in HOUST (industrial production) of at least 2% followed by a rebound above the prior low within the next 20 days is associated with a positive S&P 500 forward return as it signals a bottom in supply constraints.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls at least 2% for two consecutive months, then rises above the lower of those two months within 20 days
failure_condition: No significant 20-day positive return occurs when the pattern is not followed, or production declines persist beyond 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in INDPRO above 105 (2017=100 index) combined with a simultaneous drop in RSAFS below 700 million suggests excess supply, predicting a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 105 AND RSAFS < 700M in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when the interaction persists (p > 0.05), or INDPRO/RSAFS relationship reverses.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in CPIAUCSL below 320 (annualized inflation < 2%) creates a risk-off environment, producing a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate looser policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive when CPIAUCSL does not remain below 320 for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly PAYEMS reading above 160,000 indicates strong labor market, which precedes a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as elevated job growth raises recession risk.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative when PAYEMS exceeds 160,000 without subsequent decline.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in GDPC1 followed by a month of stable or rising values predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as the market anticipates resumption of business activity.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls for two consecutive months then holds or rises in the third
failure_condition: No positive 20-day return when GDPC1 does not rebound after the two-month decline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 1-month declines in both INDPRO and GDPC1 below their 50th percentile indicate softening demand and supply pressures, forecasting a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 50th percentile AND GDPC1 < 50th percentile in the same month
regime_hint: Dual softening in supply and demand
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both indicators remain below their percentiles for more than 2 months.
